mission: P14.1 no-host-STL negative control — three-leg comparison
purpose: Determine at RUNTIME whether the newest official Windows wheel (whl-next 10.1.0) contains the PR #13437 fix, using the exact original MIOpen BatchNorm reproducer that fails on machines without a host MSVC STL.

procedure.reproducer: C:/YOLO_PR13437_PostMerge/scripts/test_batchnorm.py (original issue-#3956 minimal reproduction; BatchNorm2d(100) forward+backward on GPU, in-process loaded-DLL provenance)
procedure.no_stl_technique: VCToolsInstallDir -> empty dir C:\pm13437_home\fakevc removes MSVC STL from wheel-clang include search (validated P13437 technique; scrubbing INCLUDE/PATH alone is insufficient), plus --no-host-stl INCLUDE/PATH scrub
procedure.cache_isolation: USERPROFILE redirected per leg -> fresh MIOpen cache (no cross-leg cache contamination)
procedure.hardware: AMD Radeon 8060S (gfx1151), Windows 11 26200, same driver for all legs
procedure.execution: sequential, one leg at a time; no overlapping GPU experiments

legs.label: Historical official wheel WITHOUT fix
legs.failure_signature: MIOpenBatchNormFwdTrainSpatial.cpp: HIPRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION (6) -> miopen_type_traits.hpp:151:10 fatal error: 'type_traits' file not found -> RuntimeError: miopenStatusUnknownError

legs.label: Official NEWER candidate wheel (whl-next 10.1.0)
legs.failure_signature: IDENTICAL to LEG A: MIOpenBatchNormFwdTrainSpatial.cpp: HIPRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION (6) -> miopen_type_traits.hpp:151:10 fatal error: 'type_traits' file not found -> RuntimeError: miopenStatusUnknownError

legs.label: ENGINEERING_REFERENCE (source build of merge commit f0a5d266) — not a release artifact

verdict: The newest official Windows channel (whl-next 10.1.0, torch 2.13.0/2.14.0+rocm10.1.0) FAILS the original no-STL reproducer with the exact pre-fix signature, while the engineering reference PASSes on the same GPU/session. BLOCKED_RELEASE stands with runtime evidence for the new channel.
note: This negative control is run on a disposable test install in a dedicated env (p14_whlnext); ENV A/ENV B untouched; no unsafe in-place DLL replacement performed.
